title: hotfix: tighten SLO enforcer thresholds to avoid cascading regional failover
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary: This hotfix tightens SLO enforcer thresholds and adds ordering guards to the regional failover path to prevent cascading failovers during short-lived pressure spikes. Motivation: During a recent incident we observed the SLO enforcer activating regional failover aggressively when transient latency spikes coincided with staggered circuit-breaker state changes. That caused unnecessary cross-region traffic and longer recovery times. This change reduces the sensitivity of the enforcer for short windows, fixes a race in the failover coordinator ordering, and adds additional metrics and tests to reduce regressions.

What I changed: 1) Adjusted default SLO-enforcer thresholds: - increased the short-window latency smoothing window from 10s -> 30s - increased the circuit-breaker trip threshold for region-level failures by 20% - added a minimum backoff timer (5s) before failover re-evaluation to avoid flip-flopping. 2) Fixed failover ordering race: coordinator now acquires the region-lock before sampling enforcer state and uses a compare-and-swap to update planned-failover state, preventing double-scheduling. 3) Added defensive checks to load-shedding: require both queue-depth and observed service latency to exceed thresholds before shedding at region boundary. 4) Tests and observability: unit tests for the coordinator ordering and integration canary that simulates transient spike behavior; new metrics slo_enforcer.backoff_applied and slo_enforcer.failover_attempts; dashboard PR link included below.

Risk and rollout plan: This is a configuration-heavy hotfix with a small runtime change around ordering. We verified in canary (staging region) for 8 hours under synthetic spike generator and saw failover suppression as expected. Rollout: stage -> canary -> gradual main rollout with feature-flag enabled default off for 10 minutes, then enabled automatically if no regression. If regressions observed, feature-flag can be toggled immediately.

Notes: Kept changes minimal to avoid affecting reserved-capacity customers. Also included a small logging improvement to help triage any remaining flapping.
